status: Page classification settings. 2026-10-25: the old BERT + keyword ladder is gone; the Extracted page type is the page classifier's (page_classify/leaf.py with page_keywords.json; the page axes cascade was removed 2026-11-22) in the page taxonomy's names (page_taxonomy.json); the Final page type is decided per continuity document (inside_progress_note, final_placement, document_agreement: page_classify/arbitration.py decide_final). bert_* / keyword_* columns of page_classification are no longer filled.

inside_progress_note.comment: Final rules (imaging_final, arbitration.decide_final). A page whose Final family becomes the section L1 (Progress Note) -- continuing a Progress Note document, or an embedded_families page headed by a Progress Note title -- takes its Final L2 from final_placement['Progress Note'][its own L1] (Lab Report -> Lab and Imaging Results), else Others. Its codability is its Final type's tag like every page (2026-10-25, user: no exception for lab or medication pages). non_codeable_names is no longer read.

document_agreement.comment: Across a continuity document every page takes the first page's L1 (sub-types stay per page). Only when the first page is Unknown or Others (neither the model nor the canon was sure), a vote of the pages' L1s weighted by page-type confidence decides, Others pages left out. The vote counts only when one L1 holds at least vote_min_share of the weight; below that the pages keep their own types and are flagged for review (no_agreement). An Others page then takes the document's L1 with the L2 the page classifier gave it there (under_l1), else <L1> / Others.

visit_document.comment: 2026-11-02 (user): a document whose first page is not a visit note (Progress / Operative / Procedure Note) is turned into one when 1. majority: more than min_pages - 1 of its pages are one visit family and they are more than half the document -> that family (the most pages; basis visit_majority); or 2. note sections: its pages together carry a heading from every group (a SOAP / CHEDDAR note: complaint or history, exam, assessment, plan) and its last page is signed -> 'becomes' (basis note_sections). A heading is a line that starts with the phrase followed by ':' or nothing else. Checked before demographics_summary; the encounter stage uses the same answer, so the document gets an encounter type.

demographics_summary.comment: 2026-11-01 (user): a document that opens on one of these L1s and runs on over pages of other L1s (a patient-summary print: demographics, then problem list, medications, history pages joined by '(continued)') is a 'becomes' document; every page of another family takes final_placement there (Clinical Summary: Summary).

long_summary.comment: 2026-11-02 (user): a document that opens on one of these record L1s and runs to min_pages pages or more over pages of more than one L1 is a 'becomes' document: every page takes final_placement there (Clinical Summary: Summary). Checked after visit_document and demographics_summary.

last_page_documents.comment: 2026-10-25 (user): a short packet whose LAST page is one of these L1s takes that L1 on every page (a consent: notice / intake pages, then the signed consent page). Post-processing for the Final page type only (DOS and encounter keep continuity's documents): 1. a document whose last page is a listed L1 absorbs the documents right before it while the packet stays within max_pages and their pages are all of the joins L1s; 2. in a document of at most max_pages pages ending in a listed L1, every page takes that L1 (continuation_rule agreed_last_page); its L2 is the one the page classifier gave it there (under_l1), else its own name when that L1 has it, else Others.

level_3_continuation.what: On the continuity stage's documents (continuity_canon.json), in imaging_final: every page of a document takes its first page's L1; a page of another L1 is re-placed under it (final_placement, under_l1, else Others). Only when the first page is Unknown / Others does a confidence-weighted vote decide (document_agreement). A page in no multi-page document keeps its own type, except embedded_same_page (a page of an embedded_families L1 with a Progress Note title on it).

sections.comment: 2026-11-22 (Brief 5 section 3): the usual order of a visit note's sections, for modules/page_classify/sections.py (first / last section rank; continuity's section_order clues; sequencing's note-order clue). Keys are the generic sections of progress_note_headers.json; the rank is the place in the note (histories may also come first).

lab_markers.comment: 2026-11-22 (Brief 5 section 3): a stand-alone lab report prints these (each counts once); an embedded result block heads one of embedded_headings.

visual_page.comment: 2026-11-22 (Brief 5 section 3, Brief 3 section 2.2b): a visual page (ECG tracing, photo, scanned image) has a Docling picture area of at least picture_share of the page or fewer than max_words OCR words; never a blank / junk / duplicate page.

final_placement.comment: 2026-10-25: Final L2 of a page whose own L1 differs from its document's: final_placement[document L1][page L1] (context_rules: page_essence keeps the page's own label in Extracted; the document view is Final — a Lab Report > Pathology Report page inside a Progress Note is Progress Note / Lab and Imaging Results; absorb_into_progress_note; procedure_in_operative_document). A pair not listed: under the Progress Note, Others; under any other L1, the L2 the page classifier gave the page there (axes.under_l1: the model's, else the canon's), else its own name when that L1 has it, else Others. Never L1 / L1. 2026-11-01 (user): a re-placed page always gets a valid L1 > L2: an L2 listed here must exist under that L1 (else it is ignored); '*' is the L2 for any family not listed (Clinical Summary: Summary); inside a Progress Note an unlisted page keeps its own name when the Progress Note has it (Summary, Vitals ...), else Others.
